newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria, China sign peaceful nuclear cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: Algeria, China sign peaceful nuclear cooperation deal.

text.p: Algeria and China signed a cooperation accord to set up a radioactive isotope unit for medical, pharmaceutical and agricultural use, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Thursday.
It said this is the second stage of the initial nuclear accord signed last year between the two countries aimed at "the peaceful use of nuclear technology."
It gave no details of the funds involved in the project.
Late last year, Algeria signed the nuclear test ban treaty, one of 44 nations whose approval is necessary before the pact comes into force.

The treaty now has signatures from 125 states since it was opened for signing in September 1996. But before it takes effect, 44 nations with nuclear power are required to sign and then ratify it through their legislatures.
